title: Rank-One Linearization Equivalence
statement: Let $L$ be a list of homogeneous quadratic equations over $mathbb{F}_2$ in $n$ variables, and let $w\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The rank-one matrix formed from $w$, when flattened into a vector, satisfies the linearized system associated with $L$ if and only if $w$ satisfies every equation in $L$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over $mathbb{F}_2$
